name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

name: Venusaur
flavour_text: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Spinarak
flavour_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavour_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Sunkern
flavour_text: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

name: Sunflora
flavour_text: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.

name: Burmy
flavour_text: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Mothim
flavour_text: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Charizard
flavour_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Houndour
flavour_text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
flavour_text: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Basculin
flavour_text: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.

name: Clauncher
flavour_text: Clauncher’s claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn’t appeal to all tastes.

name: Clawitzer
flavour_text: The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer launches from its claw are powerful enough to punch through tanker hulls.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavour_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavour_text: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed Magneton’s molecular structure, turning it into Magnezone.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Misdreavus
flavour_text: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavour_text: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Solosis
flavour_text: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
flavour_text: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
flavour_text: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Spritzee
flavour_text: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
flavour_text: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Xerneas
flavour_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Onix
flavour_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavour_text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Nosepass
flavour_text: The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

name: Mienfoo
flavour_text: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
flavour_text: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Grimer
flavour_text: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Muk
flavour_text: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

name: Purrloin
flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavour_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavour_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Steelix
flavour_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Probopass
flavour_text: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

name: Genesect
flavour_text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Ditto
flavour_text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavour_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavour_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Starly
flavour_text: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Staravia
flavour_text: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Staraptor
flavour_text: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Lopunny
flavour_text: Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny’s coat will be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for colder weather.

name: Bouffalant
flavour_text: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Ariados
flavour_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Sunflora
flavour_text: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.

name: Reuniclus
flavour_text: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Xerneas
flavour_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Oddish
flavour_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavour_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
flavour_text: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Charizard
flavour_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Shellder
flavour_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavour_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Sandshrew
flavour_text: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
flavour_text: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Type: Null
flavour_text: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Aegislash
flavour_text: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.
